Container.Name: grimmory-convert
Container.Overview:
Converts books in a Grimmory library to extra formats with Calibre's ebook-convert and saves them next to the original (Title.epub -> Title.azw3). Grimmory's library watcher then attaches the new file to the existing book as an extra format.
Starts in dry-run mode: check the log for what it would create, then set Dry Run to false. When a source changes later (e.g. Grimmory writes edited metadata into the EPUB), the converted file is made again. Files it did not create itself are never touched.
Container.Requires: A Grimmory library with folder monitoring enabled, organised in "Auto detect" or "Book per folder" mode.

Config.Name: Library
Config.Description: The same share Grimmory uses as its library path. Converted files are written next to the originals.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Keeps state.json: which files this tool created and which conversions failed. Don't delete it, or converted files are no longer kept in sync.

Config.Name: Calibre plugins
Config.Description: Optional. Calibre plugin .zip files (and their settings .json) to install on every start. Restart the container after adding or removing one.

Config.Name: Dry Run
Config.Description: true: only log what would be converted. false: actually convert.

Config.Name: Target Formats
Config.Description: Comma-separated formats to create, e.g. azw3,mobi,pdf. Use formats Grimmory knows: epub, pdf, mobi, azw3, fb2.

Config.Name: Source Formats
Config.Description: Comma-separated formats to convert from, in order of preference when a book has several.

Config.Name: Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes between runs. 0 runs once and stops the container; start it again to re-run.

Config.Name: Max per run
Config.Description: Stop after this many conversions per run (0 = no limit). Handy for a first test.

Config.Name: Extra ebook-convert arguments
Config.Description: Passed to every ebook-convert call, e.g. --output-profile kindle_pw3

Config.Name: Timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Give up on a single conversion after this long.
